rationale: FX01 flags rows where non-USD debt principal lacks principal_amount_usd. The raw SOI rows inspected through the evidence CLI show debt positions with principal/par values and recurring footnote (4), but the available source window did not expose a currency label, FX rate, or footnote definition proving that the principal/par is non-USD or showing the required USD-converted principal. Currency and EUR/GBP searches returned no source rows that decide the issue, so the source was checked but does not ground either a real_error or false_alarm.
